note: Shape A (11-phase). Architecture outputs (architecture.md, architecture.meta.json, ux-design-spec) are Phase 6 and Phase 5 outputs — not Phase 4 exit conditions. `legacy-assessment` was moved to reference/brownfield-pending/ pending the brownfield capability pack (§7.6) — WS5-B §8 item 6; brownfield legacy-assessment is not currently gated at Phase 4 (see ledger delta D17).

acceptance_checks.remediation: Phase 1 Bootstrap must be complete before Phase 4. Run `coldpress init` if not done.
Phase 3 Tech Stack must be complete. Run `@architect stack-locking` to lock the tech stack.

acceptance_checks.description: Sacred PRD `_context/sacred/prd.md` exists with `sacred: true` frontmatter
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@pm create-prd` to author the Product Requirements Document.

acceptance_checks.description: `_context/sacred/prd.meta.json` exists and validates against `schemas/handoffs/prd-to-architecture.schema.ts` — Phase 4→Phase 6 handoff contract
acceptance_checks.remediation: Re-run `create-prd` step-05-finalize — the sidecar is emitted at PRD finalization. Verify `create-prd` SKILL.md outputs include prd.meta.json.

acceptance_checks.description: `_context/planning/prd-validation-{date}.md` exists confirming PRD completeness check was run
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@pm validate-prd` to catch internal inconsistencies before Phase 5.

acceptance_checks.description: `_context/planning/outcomes.yaml` is present + valid, and every P0/P1 requirement has a measurable outcome target + measurement source (`coldpress outcomes check`). Closes the plan's biggest v1 gap: the framework measures whether the product works for its purpose. (Full P0-coverage cross-check activates with WS4-E PRD requirement-id keying.)
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `outcome-contract` (P4): author outcomes.yaml — each P0/P1 requirement links a target (activation/conversion/task-completion/latency/SEO/cost) + its measurement source (analytics event, uptime probe, search console, revenue report).

acceptance_checks.description: SECURITY-TIER GATE (WS10-E3). For a T1/T2 project (revenue/PII), the PRD MUST contain a security requirements section (a `## Security` heading or explicit security NFRs). Below T1, `security_tier` was informational all the way to P9 — this makes it bite at P4, where the requirement is cheap to add. Condition: `coldpress.yaml security_tier in [T1, T2]`.
acceptance_checks.remediation: Add a security section to the PRD: authn/authz model, data-classification + PII handling, threat surface, and the security NFRs. For T0 this check is skipped; for T1/T2 it blocks. The section seeds the P6 `security-registry` + `threat-model`.

acceptance_checks.description: `_context/handoffs/phase-4-to-5-{date}.md` exists (emitted by phase-transition invocation at Phase 4 exit)
acceptance_checks.remediation: Invoke `phase-transition` at Phase 4 exit to write the handoff log.
